title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: Publish versioned policies and track who accepted them
scopeHint: Each scope has its own active policy
publishSubtitle: This replaces the current policy for the selected scope
htmlSourceHint: Paste the policy HTML — headings, paragraphs, lists, links and tables are supported
previewEmpty: Paste HTML on the left to preview it here
sanitizeNotice: Some unsupported markup was removed from this content. Check the preview matches what you expect.
impactTitle: This forces everyone in this scope to accept again
impactBody: {{count}} user(s) have accepted the current policy. Publishing will show all of them a blocking acceptance screen the next time they open the app. Only publish when the wording has genuinely changed.
emptyBody: Nothing is being enforced right now — apps treat every user as accepted until the first policy is published.
